question: Who founded the Arya Samaj and pleaded for the right of individuals to interpret Vedas and free themselves from the tyranny of priests?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Dayananda Saraswati.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arya Samaj** is a Hindu reform movement founded by **Swami Dayananda Saraswati** in **1875.**
 
• The movement aimed to promote **monotheism** and the** study of Vedas**, and to oppose **idol worship, caste system,** and other prevalent customs and practices in Hindu society.
 
• Swami Dayananda Saraswati believed in the right of individuals to** interpret Vedas** and advocated for the use of **reason and logic **in religious matters.
 
• He also emphasized the **importance of education **and** social reform** in uplifting the status of women and lower castes in society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** was a **social reformer** and founder of** Brahmo Samaj.**

 
 
• It was a **monotheistic Hindu movement **that rejected **idol worship **and **caste system.**
 
 
 
• **RG Bhandarkar** was a **scholar of Sanskrit** and ancient Indian history.
 
• **MG Ranade** was a social reformer and founder of **Prarthana Samaj.**
 
 
• It was a Hindu reform movement that aimed to promote** monotheism **and **social equality.**
